item.title: Alex the Great's legacy continues with opening of Bunny Cafe SF in Fisherman's Wharf
item.description: San Francisco's most famous rabbit has been honored with a new rescue-focused bunny cafe. The adoptive parents of "Alex the Great" have decided to continue the therapy work of the late Flemish Giant rabbit by opening the cafe as a rescue and adoption center for bunnies from shelters. The cafe held its soft opening on January 13, 2026.

item.title: Trump to pardon ex-Puerto Rico governor Vázquez in campaign finance case, official says
item.description: President Donald Trump plans to pardon former Puerto Rico Gov. Wanda Vázquez, a White House official said Friday.

item.title: Defendant in Charlie Kirk's killing asks judge to disqualify prosecutors
item.description: The Utah man charged with killing conservative activist Charlie Kirk returned to court Friday as his attorneys seek to disqualify prosecutors because an adult child of a deputy county attorney involved in the case attended the rally where Kirk was shot.

item.title: Sarah Shahi reveals 'Paradise' season 2 secrets, reflects on being an "outlaw" in new book
item.description: "There's no greater gift for me than that." "Paradise" star Sarah Shahi reveals what has helped her build a dream life in her new book "Life is Lifey." It's out January 27.

item.title: North Bay reservoirs reach capacity after winter storms, ending drought fears
item.description: After near record rainfall, Marin and Sonoma counties are giving a status report on reservoir levels and the news is encouraging for our water supply.

item.title: San Mateo County road safety under renewed criticism following death of 4-year-old
item.description: Many residents believe most San Mateo County cities are drastically behind on improving pedestrian infrastructure and enacting safe street protocols.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Some fog in North, East Bay valleys overnight; mild weekend ahead
item.description: The mild weather will continue through the holiday weekend. Expect some fog overnight in the North and Eat Bay valleys. It may be dense in patches.

item.title: Thousands of Deadheads expected at San Francisco memorial honoring Bob Weir
item.description: This weekend, the Bay Area will have the chance to pay its respects to one of the country's rock and roll legends, The Grateful Dead's Bob Weir, who passed away on Jan. 10.

item.title: Man killed, woman seriously injured after being hit by teen driver in Gilroy, police say
item.description: A teenage driver was detained after hitting two pedestrians in a Gilroy crosswalk Friday Morning, killing one of them, police say. The other was flown to a hospital in serious conditon.
